import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    idx = 0
    N = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    Q = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    off = N - 1
    xs = [0] * (N + Q + 1)
    ys = [0] * (N + Q + 1)
    # virtual times -(N-1)..0 stored at index t+off
    # time -k at index off-k, position (1+k,0)
    for k in range(N):
        xs[off - k] = 1 + k
        ys[off - k] = 0
    cur = off  # index of current time T=0
    out = []
    for _ in range(Q):
        typ = data[idx]; idx += 1
        if typ == b'1':
            c = data[idx]; idx += 1
            hx = xs[cur]
            hy = ys[cur]
            if c == b'R':
                hx += 1
            elif c == b'L':
                hx -= 1
            elif c == b'U':
                hy += 1
            else:
                hy -= 1
            cur += 1
            xs[cur] = hx
            ys[cur] = hy
        else:
            p = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
            j = cur - (p - 1)
            out.append(f"{xs[j]} {ys[j]}")
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); q = int(data[1])
    # L[j] = head position at time j-(n-1)
    xs = [0] * (n + q + 1)
    ys = [0] * (n + q + 1)
    # negative times s = -(n-1)..-1 : position (1-s, 0)
    for j in range(n - 1):
        s = j - (n - 1)
        xs[j] = 1 - s
        ys[j] = 0
    # time 0
    xs[n - 1] = 1
    ys[n - 1] = 0
    cur = n - 1  # index of current head
    idx = 2
    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        typ = data[idx]
        if typ == b'1':
            c = data[idx + 1]
            idx += 2
            x = xs[cur]; y = ys[cur]
            if c == b'R':
                x += 1
            elif c == b'L':
                x -= 1
            elif c == b'U':
                y += 1
            else:
                y -= 1
            cur += 1
            xs[cur] = x
            ys[cur] = y
        else:
            p = int(data[idx + 1])
            idx += 2
            j = cur + n - p - (n - 1) + (n - 1)
            # index = t + n - p where t = cur-(n-1)
            j = (cur - (n - 1)) + n - p
            out.append(f"{xs[j]} {ys[j]}")
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    q = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    xs = [1]
    ys = [0]
    t = 0
    out = []
    dx = {'R': (1, 0), 'L': (-1, 0), 'U': (0, 1), 'D': (0, -1)}
    for _ in range(q):
        typ = data[idx]; idx += 1
        if typ == b'1':
            c = data[idx].decode(); idx += 1
            ddx, ddy = dx[c]
            xs.append(xs[-1] + ddx)
            ys.append(ys[-1] + ddy)
            t += 1
        else:
            p = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
            k = t - (p - 1)
            if k >= 0:
                out.append(f"{xs[k]} {ys[k]}")
            else:
                out.append(f"{p - t} 0")
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))
